description:
BROE auctioneers take great pleasure in presenting 46 to the market. Fantastic, extended two double bedroom end of terrace home. One of the standout features of the property is the generous side access, offering convenient access to the rear of the property and adding valuable practicality to the home. To the rear, the property boasts an impressive west-facing garden extending to approx: c. 45 meters, offering an extensive outdoor area with plenty of space to enjoy. The garden is private and not overlooked, creating a lovely setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing while making the most of the afternoon and evening sun.
Aughavannagh Road is a most popular location in terms of convenience with a host of amenities close to hand in Rialto, Kimmage, Harold's Cross and Crumlin including shops, bars and cafes, Eamonn Ceannt Park, Our Lady's Children's Hospital, and the new St. James Hospital campus. Within walking distance of Rialto LUAS stop and Dublin city centre, the property is serviced by excellent road and bus routes providing easy access to the city centre, M50 and beyond. Accommodation briefly comprises of entrance hall, generously proportioned living room, open plan lounge & extended kitchen/diningroom. Upstairs two double bedrooms, and main family bathroom contribute to making this an ideal family home.

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
